
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(pander)
options(scipen=200)


knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = F)
colorize <- function(x, color) {
  if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {
    sprintf("\\textcolor{%s}{%s}", color, x)
  } else if (knitr::is_html_output()) {
    sprintf("<span style='color: %s;'>%s</span>", color,
            x)
  } else x
}


## create quantification
f_quant <- paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S5-Quantification Results.xlsx")
qc_cpds <- l.a$get_table_quant(l.a=l.a, overwrite=TRUE, filename = f_quant)
l.a$cpds <- qc_cpds$cpds
l.a$data_qc <- qc_cpds$qc
l.a$has_qc <- !is.null(l.a$data_qc)

if(!l.a$has_qc) file.rename(f_quant, paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S4-Quantification Results.xlsx"))





## headMessage sheet-1 and path
head_msg <- l.a$head_msg
head_path <- l.a$head_path
grp_types <- l.a$grp_type %>% stringi::stri_split(fixed = '|') %>% unlist()
l.a$fig_tag <- ifelse(is.na(l.a$grp_type), "", "-merge")

## Other table path
other_table <- glue::glue("{rep}/{rpt}/others/Table.xlsx", rep=l.a$repDir, rpt=l.a$rpt_flow)


## sampleInfo sheet-1
spl_info <- l.a$spl_info
spl_name_qc <- spl_info %>% filter(sample_type == "QC") %>% select(sample_name) %>% .[[1,1]]
spl_name_sp <- spl_info %>% filter(sample_type == "SPL") %>% select(sample_name) %>% .[[1,1]]

## path to TIC 
fig_qc_0 <- sprintf("%s/figures/XIC/QC/%s.svg",  l.a$resDir, spl_name_qc)
fig_sp_0 <- sprintf("%s/figures/XIC/SPL/%s.svg", l.a$resDir, spl_name_sp)


## path to RT profile
fig_rt_0 <- sprintf("%s/figures/IS/", l.a$resDir)
fig_name_n <- grep('Negative', list.files(fig_rt_0, pattern = '.png'), value=T, ignore.case = T)[1]
fig_name_p <- gsub('Negative$', 'Positive', fig_name_n)


fig_rt_0n <- glue::glue("{path}/{name}", path=fig_rt_0, name=fig_name_n)
fig_rt_0p <- glue::glue("{path}/{name}", path=fig_rt_0, name=fig_name_p)



```



# 样本基本信息


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_group <- read.xlsx(head_path, sheet = 2)

if(sum(colnames(data_group) == '样本分组') > 1) {
  sum_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '样本数量'], na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(data_group[,colnames(data_group) == '实验检测'], na.rm = T)
} else {
  sum_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '样本数量', -1])), na.rm = T)
  rel_spl <- sum(as.numeric(unlist(data_group[data_group$组别 == '实验检测', -1])), na.rm = T)
} 

str <- glue::glue(
  "共收到客户提供的{sum_spl}例{spl_type}样本，实际检测{rel_spl}例{spl_type}样本。",
  sum_spl=sum_spl,
  spl_type=l.a$spl_name,
  rel_spl=rel_spl
  )

pander(str)
```


### 方法检出限及定量限

将校准溶液依次稀释2倍后进行UHPLC-MRM-MS分析，通过其信噪比来计算方法的检出限和定量限。方法 最低检出限(LLOD)定义为信噪比为3时所对应的化合物浓度，方法最低定量限(LLOQ)定义为信噪比为10时所 对应的化合物浓度(US FDA guideline for bioanalytical method validation)。


```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=l.a$has_qc}
"
### 方法精密度及准确度

方法的精密度通过QC样品重复进样的标准相对偏差(RSD)来评估。准确度通过测得浓度与理论浓度的百分比值来评估。
" %>% pander()

```

### 色谱分离

标准品溶液及样本SIM离子流图如`r fig_2`所示，从中可以看出：

  1）本项目所采用分析方法，所有目标化合物均呈现出对称的色谱峰；
  
  2）很好地实现了各个目标化合物的色谱分离；
  
  3）目标化合物在生物样品与标准品溶液中的保留时间及色谱峰形均无明显差异。

### 方法定量参数

```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
## create calibrator
f_acc_cal <- paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S3-Calibration.xlsx")
data_cal <- l.a$get_table_calib(l.a, filename=f_acc_cal)

llod_0 <- min(data_cal$LLOD)
llod_1 <- max(data_cal$LLOD)
lloq_0 <- min(data_cal$LLOQ)
lloq_1 <- max(data_cal$LLOQ)
scores <- min(data_cal$`R^2`)


```


目标化合物的定量参数见Table S3，各目标化合物的最低检出限(LLODs)在`r llod_0` - `r llod_1` nmol/L，最低定量限(LLOQs)在`r lloq_0` - `r lloq_1` nmol/L 之间；所有目标化合物的相关系数(R^2)均大于`r scores` ，说明色谱 峰面积与化合物浓度间呈良好的定量关系，可满足靶向代谢组学分析的要求(详细校准曲线见Figure S1-Calibration)。



```{r echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=l.a$has_qc}
acc_max <- 30
rsd_max <- 30
f_acc_rsd <- paste0(l.a$outDir, "/Table S4-Accuracy and RSD.xlsx")
data_rsd <- l.a$get_table_stats(l.a, filename=f_acc_rsd, fill=rsd_max)

n <-  head_msg["QC样品重复进样次数", 1]
rsd_0 <- round(min(data_rsd$`Accuracy[%]`, na.rm=TRUE), 1)
rsd_1 <- round(max(data_rsd$`Accuracy[%]`, na.rm=TRUE), 1)
ratio <- round(100 - nrow(data_rsd[data_rsd$`RSD[%]` %>% grep(">",.),]) / nrow(data_rsd) * 100, 2)

msg_cn <- glue::glue(
  "QC样品的准确度(Accuracy)及标准相对偏差(RSD)见Table S4，QC样品重复进样次数为{n}次。",
  "如表中所示，所有目标化合物的平均准确度在{rsd_0}% - {rsd_1}%之间，",
  "RSD小于{rsd_max}%的代谢物占比为{ratio}%。",
  n=n, rsd_0=rsd_0, rsd_1=rsd_1, acc_max=acc_max, ratio=ratio,rsd_max=rsd_max
)

msg_en <- glue::glue(
  "Table S4 lists the analytical accuracies and relative standard deviations (RSDs) of the QC samples，",
  "with {n} technical replicates. ",
  "The accuracy determined were {rsd_0}% - {rsd_1}% for all the analytes, ",
  "with {ratio}% of the RSDs below {rsd_max}% (n = {n}).",
  n=n, rsd_0=rsd_0, rsd_1=rsd_1, acc_max=acc_max, ratio=ratio,rsd_max=rsd_max
)

pander(msg_cn)

```


以上数据表明，本方法能够在以上所示的浓度范围内，准确可靠地检测出样品中的目标代谢物含量。

## 实验小结

本项目采用UHPLC-MRM-MS/MS的方法，采用内标法，针对样品中的`r paste(l.a$cpds[1:min(length(l.a$cpds), 20)], collapse=', ')`等`r length(l.a$cpds)`种目标代谢物，共计完成`r sum(data_group[2, -1])`例`r l.a$spl_name`样本的分析检测。
